_about: Trip ideas: the experiences list riders see at the end of a ride, from Ride ended, and from Trip ideas on the route page and in the Offers list (Ben, 18/11/2026). Order is fixed as Ben set it: kayak tour first, then the multi-day experience, the Biosphere MTB tour, coaching, then partner activities. Shown on both brands' maps. Types: tour (bookable through Checkfront with the rider code), enquiry (no discount), contact (call or email), partner (an offer from config/offers.json, the partner's own deal, never our code). Prices for tours come live from Checkfront's public item API at build; price here is the fallback. Food and drink (Land and Sea) is never in this list: it stays a rider offer on the finish card.
_bookAnchor: Book now opens the tour page at its booking section: #check is the phone layout's booking block on the By Earth and Ocean tour pages (#checkform is the desktop one). The widget's Promo box takes the code; the app shows it with a Copy button.
